limitations: The exact direct Codex get_profile structuredContent contract supports one identity-only probe. The minimized result persists only an acknowledgment and fingerprints; account id, name, email, nickname, picture, content text, and raw provider response remain excluded.

Portable storage.registry.read and storage.artifacts.read execution fails closed with GOOGLE_DRIVE_PORTABLE_CAPABILITY_UNAVAILABLE because profile evidence establishes neither configured registry semantics nor exact normalized artifact response compatibility.

Claude connected support is unavailable because no exact structured Claude response contract is declared. The contained fixture implementation remains independently portable and does not establish connected parity.

Search and metadata tool discovery or isolated native response evidence does not establish either portable storage capability. Those tools are not emitted by this provider until a later exact governed mapping binds portable input, complete coverage, minimized output, and configured registry meaning.
File content, inline bytes, raw downloads, exports, comments, sharing, copy, shortcut, create, update, delete, dispatch, and destructive operations are excluded.
Native provider responses, file identifiers, account identifiers, local paths, credential values, and private configuration values are never persisted by this adapter.
